keynums.label: Certifications
keynums.value: ISO 9001:2015; only Indian brand with CE-certified plastic furniture

business.body:
- "Established in 1992, PIL Italica Lifestyle Limited has evolved significantly, shaping the plastic furniture sector in India. From its origins in Udaipur, Rajasthan, the Company has expanded its reach across the nation, with a corporate presence in Mumbai and operational offices in Delhi."
- Quality credentials are the stated differentiator: an ISO 9001:2015 certified company and, per the deck, "the only Indian brand with CE-certified plastic furniture, reflecting its leadership in product excellence".
- "PIL Italica is distinguished by its strategic approach to design and innovation, recognising the integral role of furniture and material handling products in enhancing living and work spaces" — a commitment to "functional, durable, and aesthetically pleasing products".
- Listed on both the Bombay Stock Exchange and the National Stock Exchange (Scrip Code PILITA / 500327).
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Brand-building push] During the quarter the company ran "high-impact vehicle campaigns across key markets pan-India, strengthening last-mile visibility and accelerating product awareness" — van campaigns at Gorakhpur (UP), Surat (Gujarat), Raipur (Chhattisgarh), Chitradurga & Davangere (Karnataka) and Bengaluru.
- [Exhibitions] Participated in regional exhibitions including the Mercury Link Consumex Exhibition in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh, with dedicated brand stalls showcasing core and new product ranges, "supporting lead generation across diverse geographies".
- [Retail branding] Extensive in-store and storefront branding in markets including Saharanpur (Uttar Pradesh) and Kashipur (Uttarakhand) covering shop boards, LED signages, banners and in-store elements; branded Tent Cards were introduced across key partner locations as part of an "always-on visibility approach".
- [Acquisition] Acquisition of a manufacturing unit in Silvassa from Kisan Mouldings Limited is disclosed in the company overview, without stated consideration, date or capacity.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions PIL Italica Lifestyle Limited as an Udaipur-origin, pan-India moulded plastic furniture, material handling and waste management products company — "the only Indian brand with CE-certified plastic furniture" — that has shaped India's plastic furniture sector since 1992 and now sells through a wide dealer and distributor network under the 'Italica' brand.
